top_papers.title: Beyond Retrieval-Ranking: A Multi-Agent Cognitive Decision Framework for E-Commerce Search
top_papers.abstract: The retrieval-ranking paradigm has long dominated e-commerce search, but its reliance on query-item matching fundamentally misaligns with multi-stage cognitive decision processes of platform users. This misalignment introduces critical limitations: semantic gaps in complex queries, high decision costs due to cross-platform information foraging, and the absence of professional shopping guidance. To address these issues, we propose a Multi-Agent Cognitive Decision Framework (MACDF), which shifts the paradigm from passive retrieval to proactive decision support. Extensive offline evaluations demonstrate MACDF's significant improvements in recommendation accuracy and user satisfaction, particularly for complex queries involving negation, multi-constraint, or reasoning demands. top_papers.title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems for Medical Decision Support: A Comprehensive Survey
top_papers.abstract: The introduction of Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Technology is a breakthrough in the field of Medical Artificial Intelligence, allowing autonomous agents to coordinate complex clinical workflows, integrate evidence into the patient’s care cycle, and supply decision-making support to health care professionals and patients. In this manuscript, we will offer a comprehensive analysis of the architectures of Agentic RAG technology and its numerous applications and approaches within healthcare. More specifically, we will systematically evaluate the various types of multi-agentic systems that may be employed for specific professional and clinical tasks, such as diagnostic reasoning, medical question answering, report generation, drug discovery, and optimizing overall healthcare delivery
